description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {3}, tapping Stormsplitter, and tapping Caetus.
Stormsplitter triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Searing Touch resolves, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4} and tapping the token copy of Stormsplitter.
Both Stormsplitters trigger, creating two token copies of Stormsplitter.
Searing Touch resolves, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {3} and tapping two token copies of Stormsplitter.
All four copies of Stormsplitter trigger, creating four token copies of Stormsplitter.
Searing Touch resolves, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {1} and tapping four token copies of Stormsplitter.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Searing Touch resolves, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by tapping five token copies of Stormsplitter.
Repeat from step 11.

uses.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
uses.cardState: as Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
